origin: independently authored synthetic entity-detection materials; no model use; none reused from the 24-story corpus
unit_note: A private/public policy pair intentionally shares exactly the same payload and is one content pair, not two independent texts. Bilingual template translations also have dependence.
label_review_status: Programmatically checked spans and explicit authored labels; not independently human adjudicated. No empirical performance results.
boundary_rule: Complete designated value only, excluding wrapper quotes, angle brackets and field separator punctuation; currency units/legal-name suffixes are included when part of designated values.
indexing: zero-based Python Unicode character positions; end exclusive; preserve raw text
read_protocol: Runtime and gold separated. Freeze algorithm and metrics before heldout evaluation. Any rerun after tuning must retain the original failed result and must not be presented as an untouched holdout.
